request.text: Compose original music for Crimson Thread Pilgrimage, a dark fairytale underground action-adventure. Natural acoustic instruments, expressive phrasing, clear voicing, transparent mix with space for gameplay sound effects. No imitation of existing music or named artists, no chiptune, EDM drops, trailer braams or mastering distortion. Shared original Silent Toll motif: D4 down to A3 then up to B-flat3, then a rest; leave it unresolved except in endings A and C. Crimson Thread countertheme: D4 leap to B-flat4, then A4 G4 F4 E4, in plucked timbres. A 3/4 waltz, 60 bars per minute (180 quarter-note BPM), D Phrygian. Brief subtly detuned music-box wedding phrase, then elegant dangerous chamber strings and triangle on beat one. Ghost field-snare notes reveal the bride's military past. Second half mirrors the melody by inversion, then presents original and inverted Crimson Thread figures a half-beat apart. Graceful tragic dance, lucid orchestration, no circus. Strictly instrumental; NO vocals, humming, choir, lyrics, speech or narration. Finish with texture and harmony compatible with the opening, no big final cadence, leaving a three-second editable overlap for a smooth game loop.
